concurrency.claim_limit: Demonstrates three overlapping end-to-end journeys. Not a production capacity, latency or abandonment benchmark.

scenario_assertions.final15a: Actual $2,100 LD01123 agreement, exact caller-facing recap, senior rep confirmation pending, one goodbye and agent hangup.
scenario_assertions.final15b: Relative addition prompted total request. 2700 read back, corrected to2800 with fresh readback. No negotiation without affirmative; explicit decline closed without reservation.
scenario_assertions.final15c: Equipment-only utterance waited for missing pickup state, then used California-to-Alabama lane. Maximum-rate probe restated approved offer. 10000/11000/12000 asks led to counter1/counter2/final3. Explicit final refusal sent decline with after_final_offer=true, negotiation_failed, no handoff, one goodbye, agent hangup.

Manual orchestration and sequential inbox reads add idle time. Durations are evidence of these tests, not AHT targets.
Three concurrent rooms are a bounded integration check, not enterprise capacity certification.

Historical V13 partial-lane search and stalled caller generation are retained separately. Continuous low-level source, bounded serialized TTS and pre-generated utterances resolved the harness faults in this final batch.
